sources.title: TUPOI: Symplectic Post-Transformer Language Model with O(1) Memory
sources.snippet: This repository contains the reference implementation, pre-trained weights, and empirical benchmark suite for the TUPOI language model, a post-transformer architecture that completely eliminates the Attention mechanism and the persistent KV-cache in favor of continuous Hamiltonian phase-space dynamics.
